title: Not bad.
text: Not bad.. These are nice but thin. The pizza slides on and off easy. Im not too sure how sturdy it would be for a deep dish loaded pizza..thinking the handle might snap off. I dont worry about it because I only make thin crust lol. The edge is beveled like a spatula. The size is made more for a medium pizza...or smaller large one.
